item.title: Building canvas-native agents: lessons from Laya
item.description: Luma is building canvas-native agents that can read and understand a creative workspace and work within it. On a board that is in progress, references sit beside generated variations, notes capture decisions, and frames and groups bring ideas together for comparison. An agent needs that context to help with the work.
